decision_basis: Owner's September 18 screenshots and Nova-selection handoff; explicit rejection of code24 manual-preview UX

rules.rule: Automatic muted bounded preview is the default when an eligible channel card keeps focus. No manual Preview 12s button in the guide.
Focus on Find/header/chips, any modal/window loss, pause or playback stops preview/network/decoder work. Late results cannot repaint the hero.
650ms dwell,4500ms startup budget,12000ms after actual rendered first frame. No loop or retry until a fresh focus/selection.
A saved explicit previews-Off preference is honoured. Saving other comfort settings does not create an Off choice.
Background catalogue updates preserve selected/focused channel. Initial/category focus waits for the card layout, and aborts if the user moves elsewhere.
Retain first-panel Next focus, selected category/language/search next/previous, keyboard shortcuts and family/Simrat management.
Keep existing configurable Still Watching and resume/return-to-guide. Do not collect viewing history to implement inactivity.
Only existing Nova5580/package/hash is a review. Emulator5554 One Guide is not a Nova baseline. Never infer playback success from foreground or CI.
Code24 remains published with review waived. New code26 is review only. Code25 is the prepared previous-production recovery, not automatically selected.
